text.printed:
During step 2 of the villain phase, Bullseye activates against you before The Punisher does.
Forced Response: After Bullseye attacks and damages an ally, discard that ally.
When Defeated: If Bullseye was defeated by The Punisher, place 1[per_hero] war counter on War on Crime.
